row.notes: Per-car powertrain step. The param is the per-car vehicle-dynamics system (its +0x18 = CarLive, +0x80 = the Engine system, whose +8 = CarLive); called from that system's vtable 0x145bff4d0 slots 2 and 3 (0x1446dcf6e, 0x1446e4312), which ignore the result, and referenced by the lea 0x1409d60be in 0x1409d50b0, which stores it XOR-encoded. It reads the car's Turbo +0x5a0, FuelECU +0x548, GearBox +0x538, ERS +0x5a8, Engine +0x530 and FuelTank +0x540. FuelECU runtime XOR pairs: +0x130^+0x138 fuel burn scale, +0x140^+0x148 power scale, +0x150^+0x158 revs scale. Drive torque = Car_Spline_EvalObfuscated(RevsPowerSpline Engine+0x28, rpm / revs scale) x power scale / rpm x [this+0x4e4] when rpm ([this+0x4c0], rad/s) > 1e-6, else 0. The +0x2208 switch is Engine TurboMode (Off 0, LagSpoof 1, Full 2), not an engine mode: LagSpoof rate-limits throttle rises (0x1446e26b3); Full multiplies drive torque by Turbo efficiency_factor +0x304 and runs a 1 ms turbo substep loop while Turbo+0x2d8 > 1 (0x1446e3a27). Braking = alt + (spline - alt) x t (0x1446e2815..0x1446e281d), where spline is the RevsEngineBrakingSpline (Engine+0x5d8) value, alt is the XOR value at Engine+0x8c0 when [GearBox+0x698] > 0 and the spline value otherwise, and t = clamp01((gear-2)/2) x engine_braking_fraction +0x252c with gear = [GearBox+0x680]: t = 0 (gear 2 or lower) gives alt, t = 1 the spline. ERS (car+0x5a8) +0x1a2c = turbo +0x2fc (1.0 with no turbo) x throttle (before the run-out clamp) x rpm x ExhaustPowerCoefficient (ERS +0x74) x burn scale: ERS exhaust power, not a fuel flow; this body reads no FuelTank +0x108. FuelTank +0x100 < 0.08 with car flag +0x132 bit 2 clamps the throttle [Engine+0x257c] to [Engine+0x2580 + 4*(car+0x124 == 1)] (fuel run-out). ERS deploy: gear modifier [ERS+0x1890 + mode*0x40 + [this+0x4f0]*4] (mode = int ERS+0x1a68), clamped to +-1; deploy factor by mode (switch 0x1446e28d4): modes 0 and 1 [T+0], mode 3 [T+4], mode 2 1.0, where T = ERS+0x1980 when byte ERS+0x19a0 is set, else ERS+0x19a8 (the track or default factors), and 1.0 when car+0x9f40 == 100; modifier x factor is clamped to +-1 again, then multiplied by MaxDeployPower [ERS+0x28]; while 0 <= [ERS+0x1a4c] < [ERS+0x40] the result is at least [ERS+0x34]. The speed spline (+0x88 or +0x330, picked by byte ERS+0x1a62) scales the deploy only when car+0x9f40 < 9 (signed, 0x1446e29eb); otherwise the deploy uses 1.0 and the spline only sets a separate cap. Also runs the BrakeECU ABS/TC spline lookups on car+0x550 (curves at +0x18 inside the +0x10/+0x1000 members, plus five more bank pairs 0xff0 apart, all skipped when car+0x124 == 1). 1.0.145 twin 0x1446e4b00, 1499 of 1509 instructions equal; the ERS fields 0x1a62, 0x1a64, 0x1a65 and 0x1a68 sit 4 bytes higher there (0x1a66, 0x1a68, 0x1a69, 0x1a6c). structs/CarEngine.h, CarErs.h. | TC controller (era-tc): non-AI car (CarLive+0x124 != 1): slip limit = ATCStrengthPeakSlipFactorSpline(+0x504) (BrakeECU +0xd70, wet +0x1d60) x SpeedATCPeakSlipFactorSpline(v) (+0x820, wet +0x1810) (0x1446e2482/0x1446e2492), throttle factor k = ATCStrengthThrottleFactorSpline(+0x504) (+0xac8, wet +0x1ab8; lea 0x1446e24c4/0x1446e24bd); AI car: limit = solver +0x508, k = +0x504 (0x1446e2447/0x1446e244f). Per wheel lane factor solver +0x490 (4 lanes) -= ATCActivationRate (BrakeECU +0x21b8) while slip (+0x760) > limit x peak (+0x7d0) and gate +0x510, else += ATCDeActivationRate (+0x21bc), clamped 0..1 (store 0x1446e2587); engine throttle Engine +0x2574 = min(max(1 - (1 - min(f[0], f[1])) x k, solver +0x514) x +0x4d4, +0x518) (store 0x1446e26a5). Wet set when byte [[wheel0+0xc0]+0xf8] != 0. (engine-re era-tc round 2026-11-18, static, build d873a1c8) raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-18 at user request (lane owner review requested)
